title: Dissecting the RAD51-BRC4 Interaction Landscape through Integrative Molecular Simulations and Experimental Biophysics.
authors: Bresciani, Veronica; Rinaldi, Francesco; Franco, Pedro; Girotto, Stefania; Cavalli, Andrea; Langer, Julian D; Masetti, Matteo; Bernetti, Mattia
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文通过整合AlphaFold2、交联质谱、SAXS和分子动力学模拟研究RAD51-BRC4复合物构象动态，属于蛋白质-蛋白质互作而非TF-DNA体系，但方法（结构预测+MD）可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模，故给予中档评分。
abstract: The interaction between the RAD51 and BRCA2 proteins is central to homologous recombination (HR), a crucial pathway ensuring high-fidelity DNA repair. Recruitment of RAD51 involves eight highly conserved regions on BRCA2, named BRC repeats. The interaction between the fourth BRC repeat (BRC4) and the RAD51 C-terminal domain has been structurally characterized, while the complex of full-length RAD51 with the peptide remains elusive. This gap limits our understanding of cytosolic RAD51 recruitment driven by the BRCA2 BRC repeats, which is one of the first crucial steps in HR. Here, we report an integrative experimental and in silico approach to reconstruct the conformational ensemble in solution for full-length RAD51 in complex with BRC4. We combined AlphaFold2, cross-linking mass spectrometry, and small-angle X-ray scattering data with molecular dynamics simulations. Our results show that the full-length RAD51-BRC4 complex is a mixture of compact and elongated conformations and allow for the identification of key residues at the interface between the RAD51 N-terminus and BRC4, mediating complex conformational dynamics. Our evidence provides robust atomic-level insights into the RAD51-BRC4 interaction, shedding light on the molecular features that govern the recognition between these two proteins, while unveiling novel hotspots for developing novel anticancer agents.
abstract_zh: RAD51与BRCA2蛋白之间的相互作用是同源重组（homologous recombination, HR）的核心，HR是确保高保真DNA修复的关键通路。RAD51的招募涉及BRCA2上的八个高度保守区域，称为BRC重复序列。第四个BRC重复序列（BRC4）与RAD51 C端结构域之间的相互作用已在结构上得到表征，而全长RAD51与该肽段的复合物仍难以捉摸。这一空白限制了我们对于由BRCA2 BRC重复序列驱动的胞质RAD51招募的理解，而这是HR中首批关键步骤之一。在此，我们报告了一种整合实验与计算机模拟的方法，以重建溶液中全长RAD51与BRC4复合物的构象系综。我们结合了AlphaFold2、交联质谱和小角X射线散射数据与分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟。我们的结果表明，全长RAD51-BRC4复合物是紧凑和延伸构象的混合物，并使我们能够识别RAD51 N端与BRC4界面上的关键残基，这些残基介导复合物的构象动态。我们的证据为RAD51-BRC4相互作用提供了坚实的原子级见解，揭示了控制这两种蛋白之间识别的分子特征，同时发现了开发新型抗癌药物的新热点。
